integrity: Claim combines a new exact minimality/witness analysis with known clearing and threat-index formulas. Source attributions and absence of independent validation are explicitly stated. Potential equivalent prior coverage remains a risk.
scientific_limitations: Three-bank witness under independent pro-rata clearing, fixed unit bank debts, strict outside liabilities, common scaling of positive external assets, aggregate gross-payment objective, and infinitesimal marginal intervention. Not a welfare or finite-budget optimality result.
title: Reentrant marginal bailout priorities begin at three banks under proportional recovery
